purpose: Research-only retrieval benchmark candidate discovery; not an approved ingestion manifest
screen_basis: PubMed title, abstract, publication metadata and DOI/PMID; no full-text quality appraisal
selection_note: Three distinct question targets per topic. Topic is the primary benchmark stratum; some studies legitimately bridge strata.

candidates.title: The global prevalence of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder in children and adolescents: An umbrella review of meta-analyses
candidates.question_target: How do ADHD prevalence estimates vary by diagnostic method and sex?
candidates.appraisal_focus: AMSTAR 2; overlap among constituent reviews, case definition, heterogeneity and sex ascertainment

candidates.title: Individual child factors affecting the diagnosis of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in children and adolescents: a systematic review
candidates.question_target: Which child factors influence ADHD recognition and diagnosis?
candidates.appraisal_focus: AMSTAR 2; diagnostic-access bias, geography, heterogeneous measures and gray-literature handling

candidates.title: Rates of Depression in Children and Adolescents With ADHD: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
candidates.question_target: What is known about co-occurring depression in youth with ADHD?
candidates.appraisal_focus: AMSTAR 2; clinical versus community sampling, depression measurement, high rate dispersion and intellectual-disability exclusion

candidates.title: Global prevalence of autism: A systematic review update
candidates.question_target: How does measured autism prevalence vary by region and case-finding approach?
candidates.appraisal_focus: AMSTAR 2; authors did not quality-appraise primary studies, and case-finding/diagnostic definitions vary

candidates.title: Population-Based Psychiatric Comorbidity in Children and Adolescents With Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Meta-Analysis
candidates.question_target: What psychiatric conditions co-occur with ASD in population-based youth samples?
candidates.appraisal_focus: AMSTAR 2; population versus referral sampling, diagnostic tools and age-specific estimates

candidates.title: Prevalence of Victimisation in Autistic Individuals: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
candidates.question_target: What bullying and other victimisation is reported among autistic people?
candidates.appraisal_focus: AMSTAR 2; severe heterogeneity, age/reporter mixing and victimisation-definition comparability

candidates.title: Meta-analysis of the relationship between bullying and depressive symptoms in children and adolescents
candidates.question_target: How are bullying roles associated with depressive symptoms?
candidates.appraisal_focus: AMSTAR 2; exposure/outcome definitions, temporal ordering, confounding and included-study quality

candidates.title: Exploring the Trajectories of Depressive Symptoms Associated With Bullying Victimization: The Intersection of Gender and Family Support
candidates.design_draft: nine-wave longitudinal panel with fixed-effects analysis
candidates.question_target: How does persistent bullying relate to depression trajectories, and does family support modify them?
candidates.appraisal_focus: JBI cohort; within-person time-varying confounding, self-report and South Korean multicultural-family applicability

candidates.title: School bullying in children and adolescents with neurodevelopmental and psychiatric conditions: a systematic review and meta-analysis
candidates.question_target: How does bullying involvement differ for youth with diagnosed neurodevelopmental or psychiatric conditions?
candidates.appraisal_focus: AMSTAR 2; diagnostic-group pooling, bullying definitions, comparator selection and heterogeneity

candidates.title: Estimated Prevalence of Depressive Disorders in Children From 2004 to 2019: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
candidates.question_target: What is the prevalence of interview-defined depressive disorders in children under 13?
candidates.appraisal_focus: AMSTAR 2; diagnostic interview versus symptom-scale distinction, historical period and age scope

candidates.title: Psychological and contextual risk factors for first-onset depression among adolescents and young people around the globe: A systematic review and meta-analysis
candidates.design_draft: systematic review and meta-analysis of longitudinal studies
candidates.question_target: Which factors precede first-onset depression in youth?
candidates.appraisal_focus: AMSTAR 2; first-onset verification, confounding, geography/ethnicity representation and follow-up

candidates.title: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis: Predictors of Relapsing, Recurrent, and Chronic Depression in Young People
candidates.design_draft: systematic review and meta-analysis of prognostic studies
candidates.question_target: What predicts a recurrent or chronic course after youth depression?
candidates.appraisal_focus: AMSTAR 2 plus prognosis-bias review; most included reports were high risk of bias and this is not a validated individual-risk model
